comment: Written from the maker's source at commit 76c6d33 ("fix tags", 2021-12-12), the commit that carries version 2.0.0 together with the module tags the installed plugin.json has: the version was set at c043d3d but the tags there read Fader, Adder and Precision Adder, where the installed manifest reads Utility and Hardware clone. 76c6d33 is the last change to any file in the repository. The plugin ships no menu items of its own on any module, and no presets.
